summary.method: One frame at the middle of every shot of v02_FINAL_1080p.mp4 (347 shots), checked by eye. croc footage = real or AI clip showing a crocodilian or crocodile-looking rival (phytosaur, Goniopholis, Deinosuchus, Sarcosuchus, Purussaurus...). any croc = footage + line-art croc in size charts / stick gags. picture shots = all shots except board, title cards, text cards, maps, black.
summary.signature_sound: frost crackle (the cold is the real enemy): plant under H13 (sound only), back in S06, S11, S12 and on C03-19 / C07-13 / C07-21-22 (sound only), paid off in S19 on "It was the cold."
